dedupe_keys.name: a curated database of physical and virtual calibration chamber experiments of cone penetration tests in layered soil specimens

description: A Curated Database of Physical and Virtual Calibration Chamber Experiments of Cone Penetration Tests in Layered Soil Specimens is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "other", published or maintained by Gunjan Rateria, University of Washington-Tacoma Campus (uw.edu). This project provides a curated dataset of 259 cone penetration test (CPT) profiles, including both measured and “true” CPT data in layered and homogeneous soils. The data is compiled from 179 virtual calibration chamber (VCC) simulations by Rateria and Maurer (2025) and 80 experiments from prior literature (41 physical and 39 virtual). Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "other" project with 3 top-level files (CSV, MAT, PDF). Its DOI is 10.17603/ds2-jgf8-ak64. Keywords: layered soil,  cone penetration test,  DEM, geotechnical engineering,  calibration chamber testing. Published 2025-05-16. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODC-By-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
